title: Dialogue: Phrasal Verbs in Conversation 2 (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij ponizsze dialogi (1.1-1.6), wybierajac brakujace wyrazenie A, B lub C.

items.stem:

Y: Hang on, I'll ______ it up.

X: Where did you find your old photo album?
Y: I ______ across it in a box in the attic.

X: The concert is only three weeks away now.

X: My laptop died in the middle of the exam.
Y: Oh no. Did it ______ down completely?

X: Where did you get that unusual lamp?

X: Your cousin is taller than you now!
